title: Stop Saying "Very Weak"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very weak". Use one of these words instead:
• Feeble: a feeble attempt
• Frail: frail health
• Flimsy: a flimsy excuse
• Limp: a limp handshake
• Powerless: feeling powerless

Comment your own word for "very weak"!
